title: test(service-automation): witness parallel fan-out structurally, not by a wall-clock bound
body:
Fixes #19766
Clause-②: no

The parallel-branches case in `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.test.ts` graded a real `Date.now()` window against a fixed 100 ms bound. This replaces that with a **structural** witness of the property — what the engine did, in what order — so the case can fail on the regression it names and cannot fail on runner speed.

## Premise verified at `origin/main` first (both halves true, measured)

Base `fae870352e`. Both halves were measured, not argued, by lowering the bound to 1 ms through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` and reading the actual value vitest prints.

| Run | The graded window | Verdict against the 100 ms bound |
|:---|:---|:---|
| engine unchanged (parallel fan-out) | `expected 13 to be less than 1` ⇒ **13 ms** | passes |
| fan-out deliberately sequentialised | `expected 23 to be less than 1` ⇒ **23 ms** | **passes** |

1. **It could not fail on its own regression.** With `await Promise.all(parallelTasks)` replaced by a `for … await this.executeNode(…)` loop, the whole original case still passed:

```
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob bd3b5340d015 -> 8458aedccd39
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 157 skipped (158)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```

2. **It could fail on runner speed alone.** The graded quantity is real elapsed time: 13 ms measured on this (shared) box against a fixed 100 ms constant, so a correct parallel engine goes red on any runner that is roughly 8x slower through `engine.execute`, or on one scheduling stall of 87 ms. The bound sits above BOTH the parallel and the sequential path, which is why it separates nothing.

## The fix

The registered executor — the observable this case already owned — now records an enter/exit trace of the branch bodies, and the case asserts:

```ts
const firstReturn = trace.findIndex(event => event.startsWith('exit:'));
const beforeFirstReturn = firstReturn === -1 ? trace : trace.slice(0, firstReturn);
expect([...beforeFirstReturn].sort()).toEqual(['enter:branch_a', 'enter:branch_b']);
```

Everything preceding the FIRST branch return is a branch ENTRY, and both entries are there — true exactly when both bodies are in flight at once, which is what makes the fan-out parallel. `expect(elapsed).toBeLessThan(100)` and its `Date.now()` pair are gone; the case is not skipped, renamed, quarantined or weakened, and the flow fixture is untouched.

## Evidence direction 1 — it fires

Deliberate regression: the unconditional fan-out in `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` runs one branch at a time.

```
node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts \
  --anchor 'THE PROMISE.ALL FAN-OUT BLOCK' --replacement 'A FOR-OF LOOP AWAITING EACH BRANCH' \
  -- bash -c "OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-19766 bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c \"pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine.test.ts -t 'should execute unconditional branches in parallel'\""
```

```
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob bd3b5340d015 -> 8458aedccd39
 FAIL  src/engine.test.ts > AutomationEngine - Parallel Branch Execution > should execute unconditional branches in parallel
AssertionError: expected [ 'enter:branch_a' ] to deeply equal [ 'enter:branch_a', 'enter:branch_b' ]

- Expected
+ Received

  [
    "enter:branch_a",
-   "enter:branch_b",
  ]

 ❯ src/engine.test.ts:2386:47
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 157 skipped (158)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 1
```

Restore proven byte-exact by the same tool, on the absolute path, against HEAD rather than the index:

```
ablation-replace: restore /home/user/objectstack-issue-19766/packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts
ablation-replace:   blob after restore  bd3b5340d0151f2b661b960eacabe3be9339156a
ablation-replace:   blob at HEAD        bd3b5340d0151f2b661b960eacabe3be9339156a
ablation-replace:   git diff HEAD       empty
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (bd3b5340d015) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

`git status --porcelain` after the run printed nothing. The mutation needed no rebuild to be read: `engine.test.ts` imports `./engine.js`, a package-local specifier vitest resolves to `src/engine.ts`, so no `dist/` sits between the mutation and the assertion.

## Evidence direction 2 — runner speed cannot reach it

Argued from the assertion's shape, which is the stronger of the two forms the card allows:

- It reads **no clock**: no `Date.now()`, no `performance.now()`, no duration, no bound, no timeout of its own.
- Its only inputs are the ORDER of four events appended by the executor the engine calls. Order is decided by where `await` suspends, not by how long a suspension lasts.
- A branch's `delay` can only stretch the wait between that branch's own entry and its own exit. It cannot move an entry across a sibling's return: under `Promise.all` over eagerly created tasks, both bodies are entered before either is awaited, on any machine, at any load.
- The failure mode is likewise speed-free: a sequential fan-out emits `enter:branch_a, exit:branch_a, …` whatever the delays are.

Observed green while the box was also running this repo's shared verify lock and sibling agent work:

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test
 Test Files  141 passed (141)
      Tests  1690 passed (1690)
   Duration  98.17s
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```

## Local verification

| Scope | Command | Result |
|:---|:---|:---|
| dependency closure | `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/service-automation^...' build --concurrency=2` | exit 0 |
| package tests | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test` | 141 files / 1690 tests, exit 0 |
| package typecheck | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck` | exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck`, 0 errors) |
| derived gate families | `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, all 53 run, reconciled with `--ran` | 51 exit 0 · 2 NOT MEASURED |
| repo lint | `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, whole repo, not narrowed) | exit 0 |

The two NOT MEASURED are `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:type-check-debt`: both exited **3**, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` — each reads built output for the whole workspace and refused to measure without it. That is neither a pass nor a finding; CI builds the workspace and runs them there. Reconciliation: `53 derived, 51 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

## Changeset routing

`skip-changeset`, ⛔ not an empty changeset. The diff is one test file, and this package publishes `files: ["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]`. Probed on the freshly built bundles, with a positive control:

```
dist/index.js   enter:branch_a=0  AutomationEngine=24
dist/index.cjs  enter:branch_a=0  AutomationEngine=25
dist/index.d.ts enter:branch_a=0  AutomationEngine=50
```

A symbol introduced by this diff appears zero times in every shipped artefact while the control symbol hits; nothing published moves, so there is no release note to write.

## Acceptance notes

Out of scope here, reported to the PM rather than filed:

- The card recorded that it ran no census of other wall-clock assertions. A grep of this package finds **none left** after this change: `expect(elapsed)` has zero hits under `packages/services/service-automation/src`.
- Repo-wide, `git grep -n "expect(elapsed)" -- 'packages/**/*.test.ts'` returns 10 hits in other packages. Most separate orders of magnitude (1 s against a 60 s acquire timeout, 2 s against a 5 s request), where the bound does discriminate. The one that shares this card's second defect is `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/auto-enqueuer.test.ts:558`, `expect(elapsed).toBeLessThan(20)` — a correct implementation reddens on a contended runner. Unlike this card's assertion it is not a phantom in the other direction: the regression it rules out would await a promise nothing resolves, so it hangs into the 5 s test timeout rather than passing. Not reproducible today, so it is noted, not filed.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/template-date-offset-dst.test.ts` — the real origin of the red this card was filed beside, per the filer's own correction — was ⛔ not touched: that is #19768, held serial behind this one.
